NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use the camera to take food photos and scan barcodes.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your photo library to select food photos.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This app does not require microphone access.
welcome_1: Hi! I'm Nomi, your AI health coach! It's great to meet you! 🎉
welcome_lang_hint: I'm currently communicating in your system language. You can switch languages anytime on the 'Settings' page if you need to!
welcome_2: I'll help you track your diet, analyze nutrition, and achieve your health goals.
welcome_ask_name: First, what should I call you?
welcome_goto_profile: Great! Next, we need to set up some basic information so I can perform an accurate analysis!
profile_intro: This is where you set up your basic information.
profile_basic_hint: Please enter your gender, birthday, height, and weight. This is very important for calculating your basal metabolic rate.
profile_goals_hint: Set your target weight and body fat percentage. I will plan your calorie needs based on these.
profile_ai_hint: This is the most important part! Please enter and test your Gemini API Key to enable my food analysis capabilities.
profile_save_hint: Once you're done with the settings, remember to tap save!
profile_restart_intro: No problem, let me reintroduce the profile page to you!
home_intro: Welcome to the Home screen, {{name}}! This is your daily health dashboard.
home_metrics_hint: Your body metrics are displayed here. Tap the + button to quickly log your weight.
home_water_hint: Remember to drink more water! Tap + or - to record your water intake.
home_energy_hint: This is today's calorie and nutrient intake progress bar. Try not to exceed your goals!
home_actions_hint: Ready to eat? Tap here to snap a photo, scan, or manually log your meal!
analysis_intro: This is the analytics page, which helps you understand long-term health trends.
analysis_chart_hint: The chart above shows the curves of weight and body fat changes.
analysis_grid_hint: Below is a detailed breakdown of nutrient intake.
